ambiguities_or_notes: The main letter is one extended sentence in Russian and remains one sentence in English, preserving the ceremonious accumulation of apology, respect, and devotion.
вырваться на время обеда is rendered ‘get away for dinner,’ preserving the sense of briefly escaping duty rather than merely arriving late.
быть у Вас is rendered ‘being with you’ rather than mechanically ‘being at your place.’
The fourth-page address and both editorial notes are translated in full.
